title: MZ Changing a menu background in game.

posts.author: BeanmanBowen
posts.body:
I'm planning to add a menu background for each menu screen. The problem is the menu screens will include playable characters, and i don't want to spoil their appearance through the menu. So i was wondering if there was a plugin or javascript code that could change the menu background through an event. so i can add in an empty version of the menu at the start of the game. and replace it with a version showing the characters in the background once that character has joined. I am using Visustella main menu core if that makes a difference.
I did find this thread
https://forums.rpgmakerweb.com/index.php?threads/change-menu-background-using-switches.170398/
For MV but since i use MZ i doubt it will be of too much use.
Thank you for reading.

posts.author: Eliaquim
posts.body:
@BeanmanBowen
I took a look into the plugin and remembered why I didn't add this feature as an option: There is a way for you to achieve that with the current plugin version.
On the plugin parameters, specifically on the Background List, you can setup a condition for a background to show by using javascript:
The idea is, that you can create as many backgrounds as you want. And inside game, you just need to fulfill the condition to make the background appear.
For example:
return $gameVariables.value(20) === 3
This would make the background appear if the variable 20 has a value equal to 3.
I believe that could work for you.
If not, let me know that I will add a plugin command so you can create a background by using it.
